The choices you make will always make you feel uneasy but there's always this sense that you must keep pushing forward or the world will crumble from under you. But you must keep pushing forward or every sacrifice was for nothing. The combat system is incredibly engaging even for someone who doesn't like turn based combat as much as the next guy. The animation style is so nostalgic, harkening back to the age of animated classics like Justice League or Gargoyles. All of this wrapped up together creates a very daunting, unique and lovable experience.

reviews.title: Gaming as art
reviews.text: Gorgeous artwork, excellent storyline, complex characters, and compelling game design are threads that weave a tapestry of profound experience. The darkness of humanity and civilization combat the better angels of our nature, usually between parties but often within individuals, including you, the player, who is forced to make difficult decisions that impact the game and your relationships within it. This combines with a unique system of resource management and combat mechanics that leave you wanting more. By the end of the game (which I played for at least 12 hours), you forget the somewhat steep price (for a mobile game) because the experience is well worth it. Stoic has gone above and beyond with this saga. I will be purchasing parts 2 (on iOS) and 3 (on PS4).

reviews.title: Beautiful, creative, strategic fun!
reviews.text: Easily one of the best games ever on iPad. Gorgeous artwork and a compelling storyline replete with twists based upon a player's leadership decisions. Couple that with a turn-based strategic battle system that rewards foresight, team synergy, and thoughtful use of limited upgrade points and items, and you've got a dead lock winner. The range of characters and abilities allow lots of experimentation and the dynamic storyline often leaves you wondering if you could've handled a situation better, giving the game very high replay value. reviews.title: Wish I'd bought it sooner
reviews.text:
This game had been on my wish list for a while, but I kept putting off playing it. Well, I just finished it, and I'm taking a moment to write this review before I purchase BS2.

This game is very well done. Story, characters, art direction. Banner Saga sets the standard for how much content and world-building can be accomplished with current game design limitations. It just feels like it 'does a lot with a little'.
I don't like how some choice outcomes feel like their only purpose was to shock you, or have the opposite outcome of your desired effect with no hints or clues beforehand. Rolling a 4 sided die is only fun for so long, so you end up going to online walkthroughs which really does pull you out of the immersive experience (I played the first half of the game completely blind, and it was so awesome)

Well done, Stoic. This has earned a top 5 spot in my all time favorite video game

reviews.title: It’s Banner Time
reviews.text: Stoic has presented a beautiful game with interesting character development and a cool unique art style. Combat however can be a nightmare. Moves are turn based and movement is tile based with locked decisions Incase you misclick. There are odd combat features including enemies being able to move past you without opportunity attacks and odd ranged attacks which can shoot far straight but only half the distance diagonally in certain cases. I found the whole thing to be a bit clunky which is a shame because the story is phenomenal and the game does a great job at keeping you hooked and always on your back foot ensuring you never feel too powerful. All in all I think this brings the game to a 3/5 for me as it’s less of a game and more an interactive story.

reviews.text: Would gladly give this game 5 stars if they had the entire trilogy available on iOS. It’s like someone is selling you the first 2/3rd of a book and having no option to read the ending! The games are pieces of the story and do not have concrete endings until you finish all three. All of your choices carry over game to game and have a huge impact on the final ending you receive. reviews.title: Not a game, but that’s ok
reviews.text:
This is not an RPG or tactical game. It is a choose-your-own adventure with intermittent RPG elements affecting the story. The story and music are great. The game play is subpar. The fighting gets really old by the end. Honestly, by chapter 7 I did nothing and just died every other battle or so just to get it over with ASAP to keep the story going. Leveling up or even switching characters (within a race) barely affects the battles. Leveling and purchasing supplies use the same currency, making leveling feel even more pointless. 

If you want an engaging game, this is not for you. If you want an engaging digital comic, this is worth every penny.

reviews.text: It takes a bit to get used to, it’s better on an iPad but I primarily play on my phone. Definitely worth the price, very replayable. If you’ve just started, and are frustrated, keep playing, make mistakes, you’ll get the hang of it and then it’s truly enjoyable. My favorite pass time and I play before bed often. Amazing art, interesting story and combat mechanics, and stunning soundtrack! I love this game! Will get the second and third when it comes out ❤️

reviews.title: Not for iPhone
reviews.text:
I wanted to write this for a few reasons.
This game is too involved for a casual gameplay experience. So if you want to be casual, then don’t get this on the iPhone. 

Basically it’s Oregon trail, mixed with some nice battles, except the battles really aren’t your classic rpg. 
You have a ton of characters that you have no idea how to use them, and the game just tells you to read their biography to figure it out. 
So you really don’t feel connected to the characters or their abilities.
You take turns with the enemy, so even if you tactfully beat an enemy so you can get an advantage, guess what, the gameplay doesn’t care and it’s their turn, so why bother to be tactful. Just read their bios and kill everything, and take turns doing it, and then continue your Oregon trail.

If you get this on iPhone you will want to skip the text because that’s what iPhones let you do. You’re just taking a

reviews.title: Best tactics RPG game on iOS
reviews.text:
The tactics elements are easy to learn but hard to master. There is sufficient depth there to warrant many replays of the storyline.

Speaking of which… wow! Very mature, thoughtfully written characters. I love the dark tone and the Nordic influences on world building. Also, the crazy deviations caused by your choices in the world only make replaying more appealing.

Can’t recommend this game (and series) enough. Really hope dev makes more games at some point.

reviews.title: One of the best iOS games I've ever played
reviews.text: The finest art direction I've seen in an iOS game, bar none! Gorgeous storytelling, though it takes a bit of time off the top of the game to understand the backstory of the world you're dropped into. Smart, strategic gameplay that allows your decisions to have real consequences in the long-term. Lots of replayability; as soon as I finished I restarted to see how new decisions would lead to new consequences. Worth every penny!

reviews.title: Choices matter
reviews.text:
Fun Oregon trail choices with varying consequences. The combat is a bit of a challenge to learn but very fun and satisfying once you learn it. I almost go out of my way to start fights just to end them. The combat is not as unforgiving as other tactical games. Your units don’t stay dead for the most part, they just sustain injuries that limit their damage output and health for a few days. 
The art work and music are awesome.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Gameplay, art/design and sound are all excellent. The mythology and story behind the game is excellent as well. I’m playing through for the second or third time now. My new iPad doesn’t want to play the game’s sound though, which is a letdown. This problem carried over to the version on my phone, so now I’m resigned to playing through without music, dialogue or sound. I’m looking forward to finishing 2 and 3 anyways!

reviews.title: Simply Epic
reviews.text: A masterpiece in storytelling and world building, Banner Saga is both lush and frigid. The engrossing story and well developed characters will immediately draw you in. The battles and choices you make throughout the game are intense and carry the weight of real consequence. The only challenge the game faces is with character progression. Renown can be hard to come by with larger parties and without class specializations, characters can sometimes feel too similar. Still, you won’t find a better RPG experience. Well done!

reviews.title: Amazing by all measures & stays with you.
reviews.text:
Incredible world, story, art, music and game. I love everything about it and continually, fruitlessly, search for games that are anywhere close to an equivalent. 

I've now Kickstarted the 3rd game, bought these 2 on multiple platforms, bought some original artwork, bought the game for friends and even got the miniatures for their board game. I never do stuff like that - but this is a masterpiece.

reviews.title: Best Strategy game I’ve played on iOS, but..
reviews.text:
Fun game with an even better story. However, during the battles on my iPhone XS Max the point of view will get locked into a single position after zooming in. This makes it impossible for me to complete that battle because I can’t see half of my fighters / enemies. Really annoying when I’m doing great and the screen gets stuck.  😒

Please fix and maybe add a feature for full screen?  Will change to 5 ⭐️’s if glitch is corrected.

UPDATE

Have been playing on my iPad mini and it’s a much better experience.  The screen doesn’t get stuck in a fixed location. I was also surprised that my game continued where I left off on my iPhone. 👌

reviews.title: App Store doesn’t deserve this
reviews.text: An entire tier above any other game available on mobile. You know it when you play it. There will never be better. Just understand that at times it can be slow and to enjoy it you have to get into the writing and read the text. If you skip the dialogue/don’t have patience, don’t even try it.

reviews.title: Love the game but stuck in loading screen for title
reviews.text: I love this game it really is made very well and i love the battle sequences where you have to strategize and manage supplies and all that. My only problem is was being stuck in a loading screen after my game froze while traveling. I deleted the game and now re downloading it to see if that will work.

reviews.title: Great change of pace from freemium gameplay
reviews.text: I usually play FTP games and some are fun but end up in a slow grind phase fairly quickly. Banner Saga is such a nice change of pace - a game that progresses and continues to challenge you but doesn’t turn into a slow grind game. Character development is superb, combat mechanics is very strategic based vs hack n’ slash. All around great game for fantasy/strategy game fans.

reviews.title: Loved it
reviews.text: Very fun, the well written story and nice graphics captivated me until the end, the only complaint I could think of is how difficult the final boss battle is if you don't level your characters up high enough and instead spend your points on supplies, that said this is a STRATEGY game so maybe I just need to plan out my campaign better :)

reviews.title: Gorgeous game, fantastic writing
reviews.text:
There’s really nothing to compare it to, but if I had to try, it’s like Oregon Trail, meets a Text based choice adventure, meets a table top strategy game... the graphics dare unique and beautiful.

My one question for the developer is this: how can I tell when the game has saved? Or can I do it manually? I’ve had to redo some parts twice because I assumed they had saved with me moving on to the next area

reviews.title: A classic.
reviews.text: This game is one of the finest pieces of interactive art currently available. Superb writing, gorgeous visuals and a rich orchestral soundtrack weave an experience that the player will care about and remember. Nothing about this production is phoned-in. This is a high quality experience that will inspire a generation of game developers. Once you get the hang of combat, you'll look for excuses to start a fight. I love this game. Super fun.

reviews.title: Audio Problems
reviews.text:
An excellent game, however, after my first time playing it the audio has now completely stopped working. I think it may have something to do with the fact I first played with headphones, but now I am trying to play with my regular phone speakers. 

This is a shame because the music is so excellent in this game.

reviews.title: Great game, great art, great story, horrible interface
reviews.text:
I absolutely love everything about this game except for the interface. 

The decision based story is interesting and original. The artwork has a nice style. The game itself is quite fun. 

The interface features super tiny font and buttons that make reading and clicking difficult. Planning and zooming is broken and will frequently lock making it impossible to progress with restarting from a recent save.

reviews.title: A great game
reviews.text: I’ve always been intrigued by this game but only recently picked it up, and now I can’t put it down. I enjoy everything about the game; the story, art, music, all drew me in and made me interested in the lore, and characters of this world. I don’t write reviews very often but this is one I felt needed to be made. I plan on playing the second game ASAP

reviews.title: Easily a 5/5
reviews.text: I really really liked this game. The storytelling is very tense as you go through the game deciding what’s best for your people. The game keeps you guessing whether you just made the right move or not in a fantastic way. The art is beautiful and if you let yourself be immersed in the world, you will get a story unlike any other!

reviews.title: Honest review
reviews.text:
Solid game. Beautiful and unique art and animations. Not a very complex RPG (you feel pressed into a certain scenario instead of being able to choose your own destiny). Interesting sound track. Game mechanics are good but in-fight match designs are a bit bogus every now and then. Gripping story. 

Overall a very good game that I’m currently replaying a year after I bought it. Would definitely recommend!

reviews.title: You need this in your life
reviews.text: Holy guacamole. If you like amazing art, awesome characters, a fantastic story, beautiful music, strategy and having your choices actually affect the story, this is the game for you. I kept going back and forth on downloading it but decided to give it a try. I’m going to replay it so many times. Seriously. This game is insanely good.

reviews.title: Quality Writing+Animation, Small UI for iPhone
reviews.text:
For iPhone
Pros: The animation is unique and visually impressive. 
The dialogue and writing in general is of good quality. 

Cons: The game is a strain on the eyes for me due to how small everything is. This con would be a nonissue on an iPad. 
The save system isn’t very user friendly. It doesn’t say when it autosaves, and there is no option to save yourself. I’ve lost progress many times because I’m never sure when I can stop playing. 

The game is difficult to play on the go. To enjoy it you need dedicated time to sit down and finish encounter after encounter.
Would recommend but with a strong caveat that it’s not a very “mobile” mobile game.

reviews.title: Spellbinding ...
reviews.text:
Probably my favourite game on iOS. On my 3rd playthrough.

Just very sorry that it doesn’t appear banner saga 3 will come to iOS. Tried to buy it on Steam but system so awful it wouldn’t take my money and without a trace of Customer support ( and in any case far more inconvenient that a mobile device )

reviews.title: An enjoyable game
reviews.text:
I really enjoyed the game. It took me a few tries to learn all the intricacies of battle. It’s cool how the random situations 
/decisions required throughout the game can have a big impact on the outcome. My only complaint is that the game is actually rather short once you figure it out making the $10 price seem a bit much.

reviews.title: One of the Best Games of All Time
reviews.text: Played this game about 4 years ago during the pandemic.  I couldn’t put it down. The story telling and strategy is unmatched. I can’t believe how brutal this game is but in a good way.  Part of the drama is how unforgiving some of the choices you make are.

reviews.title: Not optimized for iPad screen
reviews.text: I’m a little disappointed that the cut scenes haven’t been optimized for the iPad resolution, so are not as clear as I was hoping. Also there is about 1” black borders that destruct from what could have been an even greater experience. The main game graphics are clear and bright though.

reviews.title: Addictive - all-time great rpg
reviews.text: For anyone who likes baldur’s gate, shining force, divinity original sin or fire emblem games - this is an absolutely amazing game.  Full of choices with real consequences, interesting characters, rpg elements (such as building out characters, skills and items), and fun, strategic combat.  A true masterpiece.  Worth every bit of a couple of Starbucks coffees ($10)

reviews.title: You are missing out of your don’t download
reviews.text:
Just download and enjoy. The story. The fighting. The twist. The decisions. It make the game cut deep but it’s short enough to replay over and over.  

Only draw back on iOS is you have to be sure where you click. That’s it and well!!!!! Worth this game. Please please more.

reviews.title: Top Tier Gaming
reviews.text: I have bought this trilogy for the PC, switch, PS5 and now on my phone. Excellent strategy game with so much replay ability. Always gotta have it on me. Story is fantastic. Cant say enough good things about it. My only complaint is that they didn’t make more.

reviews.title: Too small
reviews.text: I think this game would merit four stars, except for one important technicality. They did not update the screen size for the iPhone 11. The text and controls were too tight. It was often frustrating trying to get to a specific square, and several times i accidentally chose the storyline option by accident because of my large fingertips. I would love to continue the series, but not if it’s going to stay so small.

reviews.title: Amazing, atmospheric & story-driven
reviews.text: This was one of the most rewarding RPG experiences I have had, ever, let alone on my iPad. The soundtrack is amazing. And the game manages to convey a deep, oppressive sense of darkness that perfectly mirrors the story the developers are telling. I’ve played it through twice and loved it even more the second time. This is a must-play game.

reviews.title: From a veteran gamer
reviews.text: Amazing gameplay and story.  Don't purchase if you expect the same monotony of candy crush. This is a full fledged game with story/character development/excitement of an old school RPG, when games were good!  A true masterpiece in story, gameplay and content.  Tastes of Norse mythology with a twist of survival horror frustrations, absolutely decadent.

reviews.title: Video game artistry
reviews.text: This game has stunning artwork and a beautifully haunting soundtrack. This turn based strategy rpg has deep gameplay that cater to the player’s particular style. My only lament is that it ended so soon. Perhaps it ended quickly because the game is so addicting and the story so engrossing.

reviews.title: BUY ON STEAM!
reviews.text:
Nov-'17 update! I have the game on Steam and that is the way to go.  The game is EXTREMELY buggy on here! Regular crashing, eternal loading, it's a miracle of random number generation if you can get through this game on here. If you try, expect to restart OFTEN.  You'll find your saves often somehow corrupted and unable to progress because the app crashes. 

On steam you're able to fix these things because you're given access to the app and data! iOS forbids you from doing anything of the sort.

reviews.title: Great game BUT
reviews.text: Love the game, honestly one of the best strategy games I’ve played but the one biggest issue I have is that the game isn’t really optimized for the iPhone X and beyond. It’s not full screen and the texts are small. My fat finger can barely move a character because the play screen is so small. It’s 2020 the coding to enable it to optimize the full screen of an iPhone isn’t that hard. Please fix!

reviews.title: It’s worth it.
reviews.text: I was Skeptical at first paying more than usual for an iOS game but WOW worth every penny. The only thing I would like to see is more backstory and details just to better understand the surroundings when you first begin. But wow what an adventure. Great work.

reviews.title: Amazing Story, Addicting Gameplay
reviews.text:
Y’all I cried at the end. Immersive world and narrative that made me look forward to every next fight and calculate my response to every challenge. As the DM for a D&D podcast I can’t more highly recommend this game for inspiration for your D&D writing and gaming.

Andrew 
ChasmQuest

reviews.title: Argh
reviews.text: The perpetual loading opening screen is happening again. If it doesn’t get fixed I might not make it to the end of my third and fourth play throughs before July. This game hits the tactical rpg itch in a way that few modern games do. But not being able to play it at random intervals puts a slight damper on the rating.

reviews.title: PvP
reviews.text: I know some people won’t like this. I was just thinking it would be cool to have a pvp system set in place. You level up your party and can battle other players. Same play style. I don’t know just a thought. Other than that games is amazing!

reviews.title: No way to win
reviews.text: Graphics are beautiful, storyline is decent. But after playing through this game several times it just seems that all of your choices are futile. Nothing that you do is going to actually help you in the game, you were going to suffer the whole way through this. Maybe it was meant to teach you that Viking life just sucked, and if you live past 26 that you were amazing.

reviews.title: Fantastic Story
reviews.text: Really more of an interactive novel than a game. I love turn based strategy games and the combat is great but the story kept me coming back. Went through it the first time over a long weekend, didn't want to put it down.

reviews.title: Choppy. Please fix.
reviews.text:
The cut scenes are choppy. It completely takes you out of the moment and has ruined the story for me. Want my money back.

Update: fully updated iPad Air 3 and updated game: cut scenes flow much more smoothly than before! Game is incredible. Well done!

reviews.title: Near Perfect
reviews.text: The only way the game could be better is if it came to conclusion, but then we wouldn’t have the second or third game so thats a double edge sword. I’m just sad to see that Banner Saga 3 has yet to be released on the App Store. What’s the deal with that?

reviews.title: Font size is extremely small, too small to read & play the game
reviews.text:
I have an iPhone 13. I just got the game, so I haven’t played that much, but all of the text in the game, including tutorial instructions and game-play conversations are needlessly small.

After playing a second time, I just deleted the game. Too frustrating to bother with. It might be worth playing if font size was larger.

reviews.title: Incredible.
reviews.text: Amazing. Beautiful art, intense, nail-biting RPG strategy and combat, and emotional, provocative story. My only problem is that I cannot get the third installment on iOS right now and that is preventing me from continuing the story as I cannot get it on platforms that I don’t have, like PlayStation, Xbox, or PC.

reviews.title: One of the best turn based games
reviews.text: You can’t beat the story. You cant beat the graphics. You can’t beat the music. All in all a great game. I have played it over 10 times. A++++

reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: Really great balance between storyline and gameplay. It's beautifully done and well written, and battles require a mix of strategies depending on who you face. I grew up playing The Bard's Tale and Wasteland and this was a joy to play. I look forward to playing 2 and 3.

reviews.title: Amazing Game
reviews.text: The artwork is a absolutely stunning and the story is intricate and interactive. If you’re a fan of any fire emblem style combat type game, banner saga puts its own unique twist to that style of gameplay. All in all I can’t wait for Banner Saga 3 to come to Mobile. Hurry Please!!!

reviews.title: Resting Bug?
reviews.text: Enjoyed the first chapter of the game, except that my characters don’t heal. Not when resting in camp, not when resting in town...which makes the game impossible. I’m on normal difficulty. I wish I could get a refund, I’m very frustrated to have paid $10 for an unplayable game.

reviews.title: Immersive Storytelling
reviews.text:
The combat is very fun, but the story is amazing. It really drives the desire to continue playing until late into the night. This is the first game I ripped through in years.

Edit: Emotional ending. Not sure I’ll play Saga 2, but I’m happy to have played 1.

reviews.title: Needs bigger text during decision making.
reviews.text: iPhone 6s+. The text during crucial decision making is too small I’ve fat thumbed into some terrible situations. Maybe enlarged text when choosing would be better. Other than that, awesome game. Very entertaining.

reviews.title: Just played again 10years later
reviews.text: It’s even better than I remember! Looking forward to part 2.

reviews.title: The story made me cry
reviews.text: This game has one of the best stories ever told to stand with your favorite band of characters it’s hard to explain it it’s just amazing I’m very emotional right now

reviews.title: 4 star
reviews.text: The game looks great but I’m playing on my iPhone XR and the game is small in my phone it doesn’t fill the whole screen of my phone so please fix this problem. I will give you guys 5 after the screen issue is fixed.

reviews.title: One of the Best Games I’ve Ever Played
reviews.text: It’s not an exaggeration. Honestly. While only about 5-6 hours long it is so good. Art style, combat, story, music, and decision-making are all exceptionally fantastic. Easily 10/10.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: This games art style is amazing. The story is also amazing. The only trouble I have with it is the buttons are a little small and hard to push, other than that it’s AMAZING

reviews.title: UI not scaled for iPhone
reviews.text:
Great game, but it probably should've been an iPad-only thing.  

All of the text is so small it's barely legible, and the tiny buttons & tiles are almost impossible to tap (every single time I moved a character, it took me 2-3 tries to get the right tile)

It’s straight-up unplayable on the iPhone X, so I can't imagine how bad it must be on smaller phones. Yeesh.

reviews.title: Still great
reviews.text: It’s just an impressive work. Puts to shame all the other games that try to grind your wallet with freemium BS. No in-app purchases. Just a truly memorable game.

reviews.title: Good port of an amazing game.
reviews.text: I played this on PC a while ago and this app definitely gives a very similar experience. I definitely recommend this to any fan of strategy games

reviews.title: Great game, too short
reviews.text: Like the other reviews say, the graphics and the story are great. And I love the choices making an impact. I just think the game is a little too short. For $9.99, I feel like it should’ve been longer.

reviews.title: Immaculate
reviews.text: Story was amazing, tactical fighting great. Made me realize the level of narrative possible on such a simple model because most games lack this type of depth.

reviews.title: Still the best game ever
reviews.text: Playing for the millionth time to get ready to finally try the sequel. Who wrote this thing?! Who drew it? It’s spectacular. It’s brilliant. I hope you guys make games forever.

reviews.title: Ripped off
reviews.text: Supposedly compatible w my iPad 2 and my iPhone 6s. On the former each load and turn take eternities, on the latter repeatedly crashes during combat. For as far as I got, the good reviews are a mystery to me. English version of dialogue sounds like spammer grammar, no likeable characters, and combat seems simple. Can't speak to plot or leveling mechanics as I never got far enough. Regret paying even $2 for this, let alone $10.

reviews.title: The greatest tact rpg I’ve ever played
reviews.text: Everything about this game is incredible. If you love tactical rpg’s and want to get roped into a story full of beautiful characters and plots, this is for you.

reviews.title: RPG novel
reviews.text: Like a mix of Oregon Trail and an RPG. The story line was great, but lack of back drop info left me wondering what and where and why, but added to the mystery and made me feel more attachment to some of the characters.

reviews.title: Amazing game, not reformatted to screen
reviews.text:
The game is great, but I have an iPhone 15 Pro Max and the game is not formatted for the size of my phone. 

This makes it pretty fricken hard to accurately click the options for dialogue, especially if trying to select the bottommost icon…

Would rate a 5 if they corrected this.

reviews.title: Incredible
reviews.text: Hooked. Plain and simple. Storyline that has twists and turns that you impact with every decision. Unique combat system that leaves you in a state of excitement for the next encounter. I am so pleased with this game.

reviews.title: Best Game and Saga on iOS App Store
reviews.text:
This game…just hits all the right  levels of entertaining storytelling, challenging difficulty, replay-ability, and phenomenal artwork.

Well Done Banner Saga!

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Easily the most immersive mobile game I’ve played. Settlement management, turn-based strategic combat, and most importantly rpg character development alongside a great story.

reviews.title: Amazing!!!
reviews.text: Great tactical game like final fantasy tactics with beautiful, soulful scenes and a great narrative. Then ending will make you feel something. Played it on my iPhone plus, would recommend it on iPad.

reviews.title: Undecided
reviews.text: Can’t decide if it’s a good game or not. I can only play for around 10 minutes before the sound and music goes out. I deleted then downloaded again and the same problem continues. Kind of disappointed that I paid 10 bucks for a game that I can’t enjoy. Any advice?

reviews.title: Rare
reviews.text: I do not normally write reviews, yet here I am. This game is absolutely brilliant for its genre. It is immersive, challenging, and worth every difficult decision you will have to make. It is very much worth your time. Be careful though, lives depend on your decisions. My ire is due to the fact that I can’t play the sequel. Fix that problem, five stars….

reviews.title: An epic tale
reviews.text: This game gripped me the way that lord of the rings did. The music, themes and gameplay all work together to build one of the best stories and story telling games in a long time

reviews.title: Like playing a novel
reviews.text: I love this I love the story, I love how much you as the player directs where the story goes. 4 stars. 5 if I could adjust the font size on my phone. ;)

reviews.title: Great Game
reviews.text: If your into turn based strategy this is a great one. Keep in mind that it throws you right into the fray, don’t let your characters die early on.

reviews.title: Full Screen for iPhone XS
reviews.text: I played this game for few hours now but I can’t get that immersive experience please update this for a full screen experience for iPhone XS. Other than that I love it.

reviews.title: Love the game but no longer works
reviews.text: I love banner saga I play it on multiple platforms however I took a long break from my iPad version now it doesn’t get past loading. Tried multiple times to start it up but even after multiple 30 minute waits I just ended up deleting the game until I hear of a fix.

reviews.title: Y’all deserve more money.
reviews.text: Title explains my overall opinion: stunning game, magical soundtrack and I have never seen Nordic art to exquisitely executed. Magnificent job you guys, thank you

reviews.title: Like getting to play in a gorgeous comic book
reviews.text: RPG and story and beautiful design. Can’t ask for more, except for it to be longer!

reviews.title: Just get it!
reviews.text: You will not be sorry. The storyline is fantastic, the graphics are beautiful, and there is just a lot to love here. Well worth the ten dollars.

reviews.title: Broken
reviews.text: Almost a great game but it’s broken. I make progress past 3 or 4 fights then when I go back I am back where I started. Also don’t like the unnecessary traffic jam. Players should be able to walk trough friendliest. Also don’t like forced turn sequence. Every turn sequence someone should be able to decide who moves first.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: The art style and strategy is amazing never got to finish it on Pc now all I play on the go can't wait for to get to part 2

reviews.title: Thanks for the m1 Mac support
reviews.text: Game has great animation and a fun (but dark) storyline.  Wanted to highlight this app for being m1 Mac compatible which I highly appreciate.

reviews.title: The best mobile game
reviews.text: I know, that Banner Saga releases on PC, originally, but I never have time for indie games. So, I decide to try it on mobile and it was great experience, thanks Stoic!

reviews.title: Beautiful game
reviews.text: I love this game, and also Banner Saga 2. Its epic and evocative. The battle mechanics are smart and the games successfully create an entire world, which is what I'm really into.

reviews.title: Essential Gaming.
reviews.text: Hands down the best gaming content on the iPad. Artwork, music, story, voice acting , gameplay, originality, all stellar. And yet it is more than the sum of its parts.

reviews.title: Good game but finish the trilogy
reviews.text: Fun game but you need to finish the trilogy and give us #3 on mobile. Don’t leave us hangin.

reviews.title: Needs remote control ability
reviews.text: I wish I can use my backbone with this game!

reviews.title: Awesome port
reviews.text: Played this on Xbox and loved the story, was super excited to have it on my phone. Worth every penny no issues with the UI at all. Awesome game!!

reviews.title: Wish it would get past the loading screen
reviews.text: I played through this game once a while back. It was great. I recently downloaded it again to play through one and two in anticipation of three, but it won’t get past the initial loading screen. Such a shame.

reviews.title: Fun, but not worth $10.
reviews.text:
Really excellent game with a fun mix of final fantasy tactics style fighting with like an Oregon trail element all with a plot a little like game of thrones. 

I was able to finish it in a weekend. Will probably play through it again, though.

reviews.title: Beautiful Game
reviews.text: I’ve been gaming since there were video games. Seen a lot of crap. This one was a bit short, but all heart. Well done.

reviews.title: Tough
reviews.text: I can't finish this game. I get way too invested in the characters. I feel like that's a weak review, but it's a really good game.

reviews.title: Loved it but just freezes on loading screen.
reviews.text: I played through once. This game is amazing. Unfortunately, I re-downloaded to play through again, but it just freezes on a loading screen after showing the studio logo. Super bummed. What’s the fix?

reviews.title: Needs update on iPhone x
reviews.text: The screen is small can barely read the story and choose icons.

reviews.title: Good customer support
reviews.text: I had troubles with this on my 6s, but the developer was very helpful and let me switch to PC.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
There seems to be no way to backtrack from the Preparing 
For Battle scene, there’s way too much story written for the author’s self-gratification, and when you hold on a char’s stat, there’s no explanation about what the stat does! Oh, my Broken Chain is now at 3? How exciting -_-

reviews.title: One of the best games on the App Store

An update to the UI could fix this problem, just increase the spacing between options and/or increase the size of the text. Great game overall, highly recommended!

Abundant in imagination, flowing with gorgeous artwork, a thrilling and in-depth story line Banner Saga is instant classic rivaled only by fantasy epic novels we have all come to grow up on and loved. With a nod towards classic children's adventure movies such as the original Rankin Bass the Hobbit, the Last Unicorn, and the like, combined with intelligent strategic action RPG,it's a wonder why games have held back from creating such a masterpiece until now.

Banner Saga raises the bar, and our hopes, to see more of this thrilling experience in the very near future.

reviews.title: Captivating
reviews.text:
Banner Saga takes a while to get going, and it also throws you into the thick of the narrative and battles with very little introduction, resulting in a somewhat confusing initial experience. That being said, I found this to be one of the most captivating game experiences I've had in a long while. The combat is interesting enough, but where the game really got me was it's sense of tension and emotional impact. No matter what, your decisions throughout the game, both in battle and in the decisions you make (presented as lists that you select from) affect the narrative in often jarring and unpredictable ways.

The beautiful visuals and soundtrack reinforce this. This game is the right balance of depth and accessibility and seems like it was designed for a tablet even though it started on the PC. I can't wait for the sequels.

reviews.title: A Huge Stand out accomplishment on the app store
reviews.text:
Banner Saga is depressing, bleak, and difficult. Be prepared to lose fights and not have a chance to redo them ( without reloading ). The game keeps a good steady pace and forces you to balance leveling up characters, moving faster down the trail, and keeping enough supplies people don't die of starvation.

The combat is solid turn based style, and the story is fantastically bleak. By the end of the game I felt emotionally drained. The characters get fed up with all the bad stuff happening about the same time I did, and the designers accomplished that goal. 

I cannot recommend this game enough. It's not your typical trash App Store game. The price tag is higher and rightfully so, well worth $19. This game has given me hope for mobile gaming, a HUGE Thank you to the developers!

reviews.title: I love seeing games of this caliber on iOS
reviews.text: This is a very satisfying  combat RPG that has a way of story telling similar to Fire Emblem (a plot that unfolds as you travel with a group, gaining and losing members as you progress) while also being reminiscent of, bear with me, Oregon Trail in how you have the ability to chart your course within the many events that pop up and craft an experience based on your actions. This includes gaining and losing warriors based on decisions you made as you progressed in your travels.  I'm the type of person who loves taking diverging pathways in games, so this was a very fascinating aspect in the experience.  The art style quickly grows on you and it quickly becomes very pleasing as you play through the story.

reviews.text: So there are games you play on your iPad, and then there are games that bless the iPad with their presence. The Banner Saga is one of the most wonderful games ever made, period. No narrative gaming experience has made me so emotional or connected to characters just with still frames and chunks of text. Banner Saga is a reminder that good storytelling comes down to good writing and hard decisions, and this game has both. The deep lore and tough but fair turn-based tactical gameplay is somewhere between reading a novel and playing a board game, which are two of my favorite things to do. This fall, as the weather turns, grab a cup of something hot and lose yourself in one of the most beautiful worlds ever conceived.

reviews.title: A deep wonderful masterpiece
reviews.text: This is not a casual game. It takes time love and attention. It does not belong with the majority of games you find in the App Store. It feels like a full fledged console game but it still has beautiful details that work well for a tablet. Like, a subtle parallax effect when you tilt the iPad side to side. It takes a little bit of determination to dig down into the game and learn to appreciate it. Unlike the cheap easy thrills you usually find on the App Store, but if you take time to emerge yourself in the story, you will not be disappointed. The style is a completely new thing to me. It's like, graphic novel meets board game. It's a beautiful combination. I've actually never seen a better ios game

reviews.title: Would be awesome except for glitches.
reviews.text: Banner Saga is easily the most beautiful and well plotted story I've ever played on my iPad (or any iOS device).  The story in rich in lore, the role playing elements are engaging, and the turn based combat is challenging and rewarding.  And I just plain love the Viking theme of the story.  For that reason this game would be truly amazing if it weren't for all the glitches.  Like others have noted, the load times are often very slow and the game often crashes, making me repeat large sections of story over and over.  What's more, the game just crashed and somehow erased all my saved progress.  Now I'm stuck doing the game over.  Even with all the problems, it's still worth playing!  Which says much about how good the story in this game really is.

reviews.title: Too much of a good thing for my poor iPad 2
reviews.text:
First let me say that the game itself is beautifully done.  Terrific art, solid writing, an excellent sense of place and enjoyable combat.  It has a kind of Oregon Trail meets Lord of the Rings feel, which is pretty awesome.

But dear Lord this game crawls and crashes on my iPad 2.  I know and accept that it's an aging device, which is why I check the system requirements carefully before buying apps.  And the game does run, but I spend as much time staring at loading screens as I do playing, and all too often it crashes right after completing a battle, losing all progress.

And I'd try playing on my iPhone 5, but I've already been burned once by the confusing iCloud sync feature, which asks me if I want to overwrite, but doesn't say what I will be overwriting: the save on my device, or the save on iCloud?

reviews.title: Amazing RPG
reviews.text: Banner Saga exceeded my expectations by a long shot. I originally downloaded it because of the incredible artwork, and wasn't disappointed in that area. The game starts off small and builds on the storyline, making the choices you have to decide upon all the more important. The battle sequences are turn based and require thought and planning, which can affect the characters you choose to use. The music score is fitting, atmospheric, ambient, and even boisterous at times. I never had loading issues or lag or extended wait times as some other reviewers posted. I am running 10.0.3 on an iPhone 7+. Solid download, I'll be buying the second installment tomorrow.

reviews.title: One of the most captivating stories you will embark on.
reviews.text: I have played Banner Saga on the pic, and have bought in on my IPad as soon as I saw it on the AppStore. Banner Saga was one of those games I got without knowing much about it except that it had a good enough story. Boy did I make a good choice. rook and Iver, even Hakan, soon became characters that grew on me, and I cared deeply about my entire caravan. The decisions you make will haunt you for many chapters to come. The combat is intuitive and fun, while the unique art style makes you wish for a movie of Banjer Saga. I'm just a 23 old male, who enjoys a good story. I am not affiliated with these folks. But I'm strongly recommending you their product.

reviews.title: Beautiful story telling and gaming blend
reviews.text:
So why only 4 stars? Well this is an outstanding game with a vast variety of interesting playable characters, it's also somewhat light on action. 
I was engrossed with the story and felt the importance of every decision while also becoming attached to several characters, but left disappointed with the relatively lighter combat elements.
The combat is well done and makes you think carefully about every move, but before I knew it, the whole game was over and I had just started making some progress with improving characters. 
I get the concept of "leave them wanting more" but geez, at least give me balance. 
Basically....it's just too short and feels very incomplete even with the dramatic and emotional ending.

reviews.title: Beautiful, Captivating, Frustrating
reviews.text:
The developers of this game have poured their hearts into a gorgeous, epic, well conceived universe.  Finally an iOS game that was made with care, love, and artistry.  Some folks found the battles boring, but I was on the edge of my seat.  Each combat sequence was brutal and unforgiving, but when you actually succeed you feel a sense of true triumph.  "I did it!!"  The music is stunning and you really get attached to your characters.  

Which is where the frustration comes in.  The game is way too short and just sorta ends with so many story points left unfinished.  I only found out later online that it's part one of three.  I wish the developers  had described it as The Banner Saga: Episode One.  When it ended my jaw dropped and I yelled out "Whaaaat????  Noooo... That can't be it!"  Which brings us to the other issue.  

This game employees a kind of choose your own adventure mechanic.

reviews.title: Absolutely Phenomenal!
reviews.text: Hands down, one of the best strategy games I've ever played. I've purchased it for both iOS and on steam (computer) and I've been playing the computer multiplayer version titled Factions before the single player story mode released. This game is amazing. I lose myself in the story, the scenery, the music, the tactics, the characters... It's just one of those games you finish and wish everyone else could play through and share such a mesmerizing experience. 5 stars. iOS version plays great on iPhone 6. I hope you guys bring multiplayer when factions finally gets the update it deserves!

reviews.title: Absolute Perfection
reviews.text: If you're out there wondering about the price of the game and if you should buy it for $9.99, wonder no longer. I would buy it if it was $100. Never before have I experienced such a beautiful, engrossing game, powered with intense strategy that can capture anybody playing it. It's the kind of game that you can start playing and then the next time you check a clock or something, 6 hours have passed. I cried more than a little at the ending. I'm sure I'm about to hit some sort of character limit, so I'll leave anybody reading with this: BUY IT. You will not regret it.

reviews.title: I binge play this game...
reviews.text:
I very rarely find anything worth experiencing again; movies and games usually yield very little 'replay value' for this user. That being said, I can't wait to finish this first play through to see how else I can play it. I did after all want to punch Ludin in his smug face, but resisted the urge. 

The turn based battles also offer a lot in the way of strategy, something I particularly enjoy. My previous go-to games were Those of the Kingdom Rush series as they married strategy, UI, and a great aesthetic. Until Ironhide releases its next game in the franchise however, I will be playing Banner Saga!

reviews.text: This game is unbelievably polished, and a pleasure to play on iPad. I never payed the PC version, but I always wanted to, and now I have a flawless port on iOS. First of all because it's a fresh, unique turn-based RPG with a great story that changes depending on your decisions; but also because we HAVE TO SUPPORT games like this in the App Store! This is not free to play and there are no micro transactions, but it'd also a premium experience that needs to succeed so we can see more like it on iOS. What are you waiting for? DOWNLOAD IT NOW!

reviews.title: Fantastic, not perfect
reviews.text: Incredible game, beautiful visuals and sound, great combat, compelling story... Can't argue with anyone who says this is the best game in the App Store right now.  It's amazing.  Things that should have been addressed in the iPad port (and still can with a future update... Hint hint devs) include no back or cancel button during combat, painfully long load times, and the progress button smack in the middle of the screen right where neither of my thumbs can reach and right where my hand covers up the dialogue ... Move that to the bottom right corner where it should be on this system.  Love the game though, needs to be polished for a 5 star rating.

reviews.title: Great game, but too short
reviews.text:
I love a good tactical rpg, and this is a great one. It amazing how the it really feels like the decisions you make affect how the game plays out. Some decisions early in the game can come back to bite you in painful ways, and that's both frustrating and delightful.

My only issue is that the game is too short. It ended without a resolution in the story. There's a tough battle and pledge to keep going, and then the credits roll. For $10, I would expect a completed story. 

At the very least it would be nice to get a free play mode upon completion to let me have random battles with the characters I leveled up throughout the game.
